memory_candidates.content: verify-deploy.sh's TARGET argument for 'an explicit source-store target' must resolve to the repo root, not an individual extension's own source_dir. The script's CLAUDE_DIR check requires TARGET/.claude to exist, and its shared-corpus build is gated on TARGET/agent-system/extensions existing -- both true only at the repo root. Passing an extension's source_dir (e.g. agent-system/extensions/core) fails fast with exit 2 ('no deploy tree'). When a plan or dispatch says '<source_dir>' as a verify-deploy.sh TARGET, read it as 'the repo that owns the source store', not the extension's own directory.

On a host running concurrent sibling /orchestrate sessions, a full-battery verify-deploy.sh/run-all.sh run can show a transient failure (a per-gate TIMEOUT firing under ambient CPU contention, or a shared-state test like test-update-task-status.sh flaking) that does not reproduce on an isolated standalone re-run under lower load. Before concluding a regression from a full-battery run's finding set, re-run the specific anomalous gate/suite alone (--only-gate N, or the suite script directly) and compare; a finding present only under heavy concurrent load and absent in isolation is contention noise, not a code defect.
